records.headline: Imported copper concentrate treatment charges continued to decline; some El Teniente development work suspended
facts: SMM imported copper concentrate index -$173.91/dmt, down $14.54/dmt WoW.
China July copper concentrate imports 2.379Mt, +1.88% MoM and -6.93% YoY.
Eleven-port concentrate stocks 692,000t on Aug 6, +27,600t from Jul 31.

records.headline: LME gripped by flash squeeze as copper tensions boil over
facts: Cash premium reached $545/t during the squeeze.
Live LME stocks had fallen to just over 103,000t.
More than 38,000t was delivered into LME warehouses as shorts responded.

records.headline: East China inventory drawdown exceeded expectations
facts: Shanghai inventory 70,800t, down 12,300t from prior Thursday.
Imported arrivals were limited by unfavorable SHFE/LME ratio and shipment delays.

records.headline: US tariff threat upends copper surplus as prices test all-time peak
facts: COMEX inventories reached 675,185t after sustained increases.
US refined copper imports were almost 885,000t in H1 2026.
Large LME withdrawal orders tightened non-US availability.
